title: Vercel exposes build-cache size as OpenAI adds scheduled agent runs
summary: In October 23 updates, Vercel made saved build-cache size visible in deployment details, while OpenAI introduced scheduled automations for Agents API sessions. Both changes make recurring development work easier to inspect, but scheduling a task is not the same as confirming it finished.
imageAlt: A web build cache panel beside a clock sending scheduled work to an agent session
imageCaption: Original illustration of build-cache inspection and scheduled agent sessions; not a product screenshot.

sections.heading: Build-cache size is now visible on Vercel deployments
paragraphs: Vercel said on October 23 that deployment summaries now show how much build cache a deployment saved and how close that amount is to the build machine's limit. The figures are also available through `vercel inspect` in CLI version 65.1.0 or newer and through the get-deployment REST API. The display is enabled by default on all plans for deployments built on or after October 21.

The distinction matters for frontend projects with large dependency trees or generated assets: Vercel says uploading cache consumes billable build time, while a cache above the machine limit is discarded and the next build starts without it. Seeing the saved size helps a team diagnose unexpectedly slow builds; the new display does not itself shrink dependencies or improve cache reuse.

sections.heading: Agents API sessions can start from a saved schedule
paragraphs: An October 23 OpenAI developer-community announcement introduced scheduled automations for the Agents API. Developers can set a recurring cron expression with a time zone or choose a one-time future timestamp. Each run can start a new session for independent work or send instructions to an existing session that retains earlier context. An agent can also create or manage schedules in its own session when the `automations` tool is enabled.

OpenAI's guide separates schedule delivery from task completion: an invocation records an attempt to send work to a session, and a completed delivery only means the session accepted it. Applications still need to follow session events to learn whether the work succeeded and decide how to notify users. A recurring frontend audit or content workflow therefore needs both a schedule and a way to check outcomes; neither the schedule nor a green delivery status is proof that the requested result was produced.

zh-TW.title: Vercel 顯示建置快取大小，OpenAI Agents API 加入排程執行
zh-TW.summary: 10 月 23 日的更新中，Vercel 讓部署頁面顯示已儲存的建置快取大小；OpenAI 則為 Agents API 工作階段加入排程自動化。兩項功能讓例行開發工作更容易追蹤，但排程送出任務不等於任務已完成。
zh-TW.imageAlt: 網頁建置快取面板旁的時鐘，將排程工作送到代理工作階段
zh-TW.imageCaption: 呈現建置快取檢查與代理排程執行的原創插畫，並非產品截圖。

sections.heading: Vercel 部署頁面現在看得到建置快取大小
paragraphs: Vercel 在 10 月 23 日表示，部署摘要現在會顯示該次部署儲存了多少建置快取，以及距離建置機器的上限還有多遠。使用 65.1.0 或更新版本的 CLI，也能透過 `vercel inspect` 查看；取得部署資料的 REST API 同樣提供這些資訊。這項顯示功能預設適用於所有方案，涵蓋 10 月 21 日起建立的部署。
對依賴套件眾多或會產生大量資產的前端專案，這個差別值得留意：Vercel 說明，快取上傳時間會計入收費的建置時間；若快取超過機器上限，則會被捨棄，下次建置便無法使用它。看到儲存量有助於調查建置為何突然變慢，但顯示數字本身不會縮小依賴或改善快取重用率。

sections.heading: Agents API 工作階段可依儲存的排程啟動
paragraphs: OpenAI 開發者社群於 10 月 23 日公告，Agents API 加入排程自動化。開發者可用 cron 表達式與時區設定週期任務，也可指定未來時間只執行一次。每次觸發能建立新的工作階段，處理彼此獨立的工作；也能把指示送進保留先前脈絡的既有工作階段。若啟用 `automations` 工具，代理也可以在自己的工作階段建立或管理排程。
OpenAI 指南明確區分任務送達與真正完成：invocation 只記錄將工作送往工作階段的嘗試，顯示送達完成也僅代表工作階段接受了任務。應用程式仍需追蹤工作階段事件，才能知道工作是否成功並決定如何通知使用者。因此，週期性的前端稽核或內容流程除了排程，也需要檢查結果的機制；排程設定與成功送達狀態都不能單獨證明產出已完成。
